title.narrative: ORISSA Integrated Irrigated Agriculture & Water Management Investment Program - Project 1

description.narrative: The Project aims to (i) enhance productivity and sustainability of existing underutilized and underperforming major, medium, and minor irrigation systems with participatory irrigation management, and (ii) strengthen institutions for sustainable irrigation service delivery and associated support services, and for initiating operations for integrated water resources management on the basis of river basins. Its tentative scope includes (i) participatory scheme design and WUA strengthening; (ii) irrigation and associated infrastructure; (iii) agriculture and fishery development support; (iv) establishing sustainable O&M mechanisms; and (iv) institutional strengthening and project management.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: 1. Enhanced productivity, water use efficiency, and sustainability of irrigated agriculture in the selected existing schemes in 70,000 ha 2. improved institutional performance of irrigation service delivery with empowered WUAs
Increased crop production (50%) Progress/Status: Increased crop production from 3.5-4.0 tons per ha up to 5.5 -6.5 tons (57%-63%). Data Source: Same as above Actual value:

Increased irrigated area (40%): Baseline = 30% area deprived in major and medium, and 75% in minor lift schemes. Progress/Status: Operational irrigated area increased by 46%; crop intensity increased by 115% from base year 2009-2010; high value crops (vegetable and others) only 5%. Data Source: State and district statisticis, project progress and completion reports, Project MIS Actual value:

WUAs (121 in major and medium schemes) receives water satisfactorily Progress/Status: DOWR and WUAs have maintenance roles, and have achieved targets in production. No end-line survey; PCR survey showed most were satisfied. Data Source: Same as above Actual value:

State government maintains full allocation policy for O&M Progress/Status: The government provides funds for maintenance attempts made at adjusting water tariffs. Data Source: Saame as above Base year: 2007
Output/s as listed by the project staff.
